TASK_ASSIGNMENT.label: Task Assigned

EVALUATION_REMINDER.description: Automated reminder for leaders to complete intern evaluations

APPLICATION_INVITE.description: Sent when inviting candidate to submit onboarding policies via secure link

APPLICATION_APPROVED.description: Sent when onboarding registration is approved with login credentials

APPLICATION_REJECTED.label: Onboarding Rejected
APPLICATION_REJECTED.description: Sent when candidate onboarding registration is rejected

USER_CREATED.label: Account Created
USER_CREATED.description: Sent when a new user account is created by an administrator

PASSWORD_RESET.description: Sent when a user requests password reset with device and IP security info

SECURITY_ALERT.label: Security Login Alert
SECURITY_ALERT.description: Sent when new login is detected with revoke session button

MEETING_INVITATION.label: Meeting Invitation
MEETING_INVITATION.description: Sent to attendees when they are invited to a meeting

MEETING_CREATED.label: Meeting Created
MEETING_CREATED.description: Sent to attendees when a new meeting is scheduled

MEETING_CANCELLED.label: Meeting Cancelled
MEETING_CANCELLED.description: Sent to attendees when a scheduled meeting is cancelled

ABSENCE_SUBMITTED.label: Absence Submitted
ABSENCE_SUBMITTED.description: Sent to leader/admin when an intern requests meeting absence

ABSENCE_REVIEWED.label: Absence Reviewed
ABSENCE_REVIEWED.description: Sent to intern when their absence request is approved or rejected

TASK_ASSIGNMENT_REJECTED.label: Task Assignment Rejected
TASK_ASSIGNMENT_REJECTED.description: Sent to assigner when a task assignment is rejected by a leader
